notes.albums: Nine albums: an uncaptioned opener (p1-p5), then training set, retro half zip, hoodie and jacket, half zip, full zip, fan version, retro, player version.
notes.uncaptionedOpener: p1-p5 carries no caption. Every photograph is a jersey laid out with matching shorts on the supplier's green pitch backdrop, which is how this supplier shoots kids kits, and three of the five hash-match live kids kits at distance 0-2. Read as kids sets.
notes.kitColours: The hash matches settle the 2026/27 Real Madrid palette, which the eye alone was getting wrong: AWAY is dark green (p1 kids, p68 player), THIRD is red/pink (p2 kids, p69 player), HOME is white with a green collar and pink shoulder stripes (p31, p33). Named accordingly throughout.
notes.p65: Sits inside the retro album but is a modern Emirates 'Fly Better' navy shirt, not a retro. Priced as a retro on the client's caption; FLAG FOR CLIENT.
notes.p18p19: The only two photographs in this team that are the same garment - two views of the black hoodie. Everything else is one photograph, one garment.
